verdict.rationale: Pika documents a first-party Upscale app that adds resolution to any image or video, including low-resolution clips, which covers the 'upscale the chosen take' half of the story. The pack does not document a cheaper or faster draft mode, or a per-mode credit cost, for iterating before finalizing. missing for 10: a documented low-cost draft/preview generation mode, an explicit draft-to-final upscale workflow, credit or cost comparison between modes, hands-on corroboration of upscale quality.
